name: bangladesh-map
description: Open, agent-friendly atlas of Bangladesh administrative units (division to union) with an interactive map

scripts.build:data: node pipeline/fetch.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 pipeline/geometry.mjs && node pipeline/census.mjs && node pipeline/units.mjs && node pipeline/population.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 pipeline/boundaries.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
